verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general programmatic access: a REST API and CLI said to cover the entire platform, with an OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe. It also shows a balance-check capability and the existence of teams. None of it shows usage or billing breakdowns, invoices or spend reports that can be pulled via API, or any way to attribute GPU spend by team or workload. missing for 10: documented usage/billing breakdown API or CLI endpoint, per-team or per-workload spend attribution (tags/labels), exportable invoices or cost reports, independent corroboration.
